changes.text: The house garage no longer fails to hand over its keys
Vehicles stored in the garage can be taken out again after a house key has been handed over
Taking a vehicle out can no longer be triggered twice, either by double-clicking or by two players clicking at the same time
The cleaning robot no longer spawns two or three times in certain situations
All furniture is now cleared correctly when leaving a property that contains a large amount of interior furniture

entries.title: 4K scaling, police raid and key permissions

changes.text: The interface is now much larger on 2K and 4K displays, and a manual scale option has been added to the decoration menu settings
Police: a Raid button has been added to the [G] Inspect menu. It opens every door and stash in the property to the police for 10 minutes
Admins can no longer open house stashes directly
Key permissions now take effect immediately when they are changed
Key holders with the owner permission can now create lights
The light placement flow has been clarified so it is no longer confusing to add a light
The key prompt UI no longer breaks in certain situations
Players who have just been given a new key can now see the garage
Several optimizations have been made across the script

entries.title: Rebuilt gizmo and furniture editing settings

changes.text: Furniture editing now has its own settings, so you can fine-tune things like the freecam speed
X, Y and Z values can now be changed directly from the screen while placing an object
A new page has been added while moving an object
The For Sale sign is now functional
The gizmo has been rebuilt from scratch
The camera permission on keys now grants full camera access instead of only allowing cameras to be added
Island and building placement has been moved out of house creation into its own page under /housing, and now works correctly
The bills page is now paginated and easier to read instead of listing every bill at once
The mouse no longer jumps to the top left of the screen for some players
Objects that had been resized can now be selected with left click again
The UI no longer breaks when a light is confirmed with E while manual placement mode is active
The doorbell can be rung again after entering and leaving a property
Pressing E at the garage now opens the garage instead of doing nothing
A Lights page has been added to the property management panel. You can place lights anywhere inside the house or in the garden with the color, intensity and position you want
Permissions can now be selected in bulk while handing over a key
Moving, rotating and scaling furniture have been split onto three separate keys
The cleaning robot has been improved
Players no longer fall under the map when leaving a property
Cleaning a property manually now updates for everyone inside, not only for the player who cleaned it
A broken prop no longer freezes the game
Several garage issues have been fixed
